findings.title: Request to extend coaching eligibility to senior individual contributors / principal engineers
findings.description: Customer's quality managers asked whether coaching could extend beyond people-managers to senior ICs who influence behavior without a reporting line. Tomás confirms the program already supports this population ('We support that well'); the only open item is which internal tier qualifies (settled on principal engineers, ~8 people) and how many seats to model. This is a services/seat-scoping and program-eligibility decision, not a defect in or missing capability of the BetterBark product itself.
findings.quote: the coaching could extend to their senior individual contributors, not just people managers
findings.severity_reason: Not a product gap; purely a commercial/program-scope decision already supported by the existing offering.
findings.match_note: No tracked issue matches; this is a services/eligibility scoping request, not a product defect or missing capability — product already supports coaching this population per L40.
